Plot Individuals Coloured by Genetic Cluster

Source: R/parent_selection.R
plot_selection_clusters.Rd

Companion plot to cluster_selection_groups: PC1 vs PC2 of the same (variance-scaled) retained-PC subspace used for clustering, coloured by cluster membership – distinct from plot_parent_selection_pca, which colours by GA/TS/Both/ Neither selection-group membership instead. Read them together: this plot shows where the genetic clusters are; cluster_selection_groups() $table shows how well each selection method represents each cluster.

Usage

plot_selection_clusters(cluster_res, save_path = NULL, width = 7, height = 5.5)

Arguments

cluster_res

List returned by cluster_selection_groups.

save_path

Optional file path ending in .pdf. When supplied, the plot is also saved via ggplot2::ggsave() at 300 dpi. NULL (default) does not save to disk.

width, height

Numeric, PDF dimensions in inches, used only when save_path is supplied. Defaults 7, 5.5.

Value

A ggplot2 object (returned whether or not save_path is supplied).

See also

cluster_selection_groups, plot_parent_selection_pca

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
cl <- cluster_selection_groups(res$G, ga_selected = ga$selected,
                               ts_selected = ts$selected, n_clusters = 3)
plot_selection_clusters(cl, save_path = "clusters.pdf")
} # }
